question: 目前系统里一共有多少个正常状态的用户？
sql: SELECT COUNT(*) AS user_count FROM users WHERE status = 1;

question: 所有状态为已支付、已发货或已完成的订单，它们的实际支付总金额是多少？
sql: SELECT SUM(pay_amount) AS total_pay_amount FROM orders WHERE status IN (1, 2, 3);

question: 当前上架商品中，单价最高的商品价格是多少？
sql: SELECT MAX(price) AS max_price FROM products WHERE is_on_sale = 1;

question: 统计一下订单明细表中发生过退款的记录条数
sql: SELECT COUNT(*) AS refund_item_count FROM order_items WHERE refund_amount > 0;

question: 计算所有已完成订单的平均实付金额
sql: SELECT AVG(pay_amount) AS avg_pay_amount FROM orders WHERE status = 3;

question: 库存为0的商品一共有多少个？
sql: SELECT COUNT(*) AS zero_stock_count FROM products WHERE stock = 0;

question: 按类目统计上架商品的数量，并按数量从多到少排列
sql: SELECT category_id, COUNT(*) AS product_count FROM products WHERE is_on_sale = 1 GROUP BY category_id ORDER BY product_count DESC;

question: 列出每个用户的已完成订单数，只显示订单数大于5的用户，按订单数降序排
sql: SELECT user_id, COUNT(*) AS completed_order_count FROM orders WHERE status = 3 GROUP BY user_id HAVING completed_order_count > 5 ORDER BY completed_order_count DESC;

question: 统计各订单状态的订单数量，按状态值升序展示
sql: SELECT status, COUNT(*) AS order_count FROM orders GROUP BY status ORDER BY status ASC;

question: 查询每个商品的总销量（含所有订单明细），取销量前10名并按销量降序
sql: SELECT product_id, SUM(quantity) AS total_qty FROM order_items GROUP BY product_id ORDER BY total_qty DESC LIMIT 10;

question: 按二级类目统计商品平均价格，结果按平均价格从高到低排序
sql: SELECT c.id AS category_id, c.name AS category_name, AVG(p.price) AS avg_price FROM products p JOIN categories c ON p.category_id = c.id WHERE c.level = 2 AND p.is_on_sale = 1 GROUP BY c.id, c.name ORDER BY avg_price DESC;

question: 统计每个月新注册的用户数，按注册时间月份升序排列
sql: SELECT DATE_FORMAT(register_time, '%Y-%m') AS reg_month, COUNT(*) AS user_count FROM users GROUP BY reg_month ORDER BY reg_month ASC;

question: 查找用户标签中包含vip且账号状态正常的用户ID和用户名
sql: SELECT id, username FROM users WHERE JSON_CONTAINS(user_tags, '"vip"') AND status = 1;

question: 找出收货地址为空字符串或NULL、且状态为待支付的订单ID
sql: SELECT id FROM orders WHERE status = 0 AND (shipping_address IS NULL OR shipping_address = '');

question: 查询单价在100到500之间、库存大于10且已上架的商品名称和价格
sql: SELECT name, price FROM products WHERE price BETWEEN 100 AND 500 AND stock > 10 AND is_on_sale = 1;

question: 查找实际支付金额比原价少超过50元的订单，只统计已支付、已发货和已完成状态的订单，返回订单ID和优惠差额
sql: SELECT id, (order_amount - pay_amount) AS discount_diff FROM orders WHERE status IN (1, 2, 3) AND (order_amount - pay_amount) > 50;

question: 找出手机号不为空且未脱敏（不含星号）的正常用户ID和手机号
sql: SELECT id, phone FROM users WHERE status = 1 AND phone IS NOT NULL AND phone != '' AND phone NOT LIKE '%*%';

question: 查询同时包含high_value和vip两个标签的用户数量
sql: SELECT COUNT(*) AS user_count FROM users WHERE JSON_CONTAINS(user_tags, '"high_value"') AND JSON_CONTAINS(user_tags, '"vip"');

question: 统计最近7天内每天的新增订单数量，按日期升序排列
sql: SELECT DATE(create_time) AS order_date, COUNT(*) AS order_count FROM orders WHERE create_time >= DATE_SUB(CURDATE(), INTERVAL 7 DAY) GROUP BY order_date ORDER BY order_date ASC;

question: 查询上个月完成支付的订单总数，只统计已支付、已发货和已完成状态的订单
sql: SELECT COUNT(*) AS paid_order_count FROM orders WHERE status IN (1, 2, 3) AND pay_time >= DATE_FORMAT(DATE_SUB(CURDATE(), INTERVAL 1 MONTH), '%Y-%m-01') AND pay_time < DATE_FORMAT(CURDATE(), '%Y-%m-01');

question: 找出注册时间超过一年但从未登录过的用户ID
sql: SELECT id FROM users WHERE register_time < DATE_SUB(NOW(), INTERVAL 1 YEAR) AND last_login_time IS NULL;

question: 按小时（0-23）统计所有订单的创建数量分布
sql: SELECT HOUR(create_time) AS hour, COUNT(*) AS order_count FROM orders GROUP BY hour ORDER BY hour;

question: 统计本季度每个月已支付、已发货和已完成状态订单的金额总和，按月份升序
sql: SELECT DATE_FORMAT(pay_time, '%Y-%m') AS pay_month, SUM(pay_amount) AS total_amount FROM orders WHERE status IN (1, 2, 3) AND QUARTER(pay_time) = QUARTER(CURDATE()) AND YEAR(pay_time) = YEAR(CURDATE()) GROUP BY pay_month ORDER BY pay_month ASC;

question: 查询今天下单且状态为已支付、已发货或已完成的订单中，支付时间与下单时间间隔超过1小时的订单ID
sql: SELECT id FROM orders WHERE DATE(create_time) = CURDATE() AND status IN (1, 2, 3) AND TIMESTAMPDIFF(HOUR, create_time, pay_time) >= 1;

question: 找出购买过所有已下架商品的订单对应的用户ID（去重）
sql: SELECT o.user_id FROM orders o JOIN order_items oi ON o.id = oi.order_id JOIN products p ON oi.product_id = p.id WHERE p.is_on_sale = 0 GROUP BY o.user_id HAVING COUNT(DISTINCT p.id) = (SELECT COUNT(*) FROM products WHERE is_on_sale = 0);

question: 查询累计实付金额排名前3的用户ID及其总消费额，仅统计已支付、已发货和已完成状态的订单
sql: SELECT user_id, total_spent FROM (SELECT user_id, SUM(pay_amount) AS total_spent FROM orders WHERE status IN (1, 2, 3) GROUP BY user_id ORDER BY total_spent DESC LIMIT 3) t;

question: 找出没有任何退款记录的订单ID，只考虑已支付、已发货和已完成状态的订单
sql: SELECT o.id FROM orders o WHERE o.status IN (1, 2, 3) AND NOT EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM order_items oi WHERE oi.order_id = o.id AND oi.refund_amount > 0);
